task: Establish combined v2 oracle conformance and audit generated native clones.
observation: The fresh 60-fixture oracle run completed with semantic and engine results available, but 33 fixtures could not pass clone acceptance because generated native artifacts have no compiler-attested v2 provenance sidecars. Across debug and optimized outputs, 494 clone occurrences remain unclassified; the harness reports missing provenance rather than treating them as authorized or asserting they are all semantically hidden clones.
impact: The final acceptance gate cannot certify the clone budget until compiler-emitted provenance is tied to checked copy authority. Keeping this category separate prevents missing evidence from masking semantic status.

resolution.summary: No clone was marked authorized without provenance. Compiler-attested provenance or removal of the affected generated clones remains necessary for final acceptance.

task: Bind runtime clone observations to exact generator sites while keeping authorization separate.
observation: The marker-bound v3 sidecar now reports exact C++ source blob/span and Rust operator/context identity as source_site_only_unapproved. A focused probe showed one FileChunk generator callsite may expand multiple times in a Moss artifact; assigning ordered generated occurrence indices retained every expansion while preserving one source-site identity. The authorization allowlist remains empty.
impact: Reviewers can distinguish one generator site expanded several times from duplicate or relocated source markers without converting runtime clone observations into semantic authorization.

resolution.summary: Observations remain unapproved pending exact per-site lifetime review and fresh Team C / Agent 2 approval.
